# GreenPulse Wellness

> GreenPulse designs, equips and launches recovery and wellness spaces in India: layout planning, one catalogue of heat, cold, light and relaxation products, installation, team training and launch support. We work with wellness centres, gyms, clinics, hotel spas, senior living and homes.

Website: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com
Contact: welcome@greenpulsewellness.com | WhatsApp: +91 75500 22504
Region: India

Headline: Designed. Equipped. Launched.

---

## What We Do

1. **Design**: We plan the whole space, including the layout, power, drainage and ventilation notes.
2. **Equip**: Heat, cold, light and relaxation products from one catalogue, each with a standard spec sheet.
3. **Launch**: Installation, safety checks, team training and help planning your session menu and opening.

---

## Four Ways We Equip a Space

- **Recover & Restore**: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/recover - Infrared saunas, cold plunges, compression and massage chairs for wellness centres, hotel spas and gyms.
- **AgeWell**: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/agewell - Comfortable seating and mobility products for senior living and care settings.
- **Rehabilitate**: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/rehabilitate - Practical equipment for physiotherapy and chiropractic practices.
- **Live Well**: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com/solutions/live-well - Comfort and recovery products for clinics, care settings and homes.

---

## Product Families

Products appear in this order: Relax, Heat, Light, Cold, Air.

- **Serene** - massage chairs
- **Halo** - infrared and hybrid saunas
- **Luma** - LED red light and near-infrared devices
- **Arctic** - cold plunges and cryo systems
- **Oxa** - chambers, listed with specifications for supervised settings only; enquire for details
- **PulseWave** - compression systems
- **Thrum, Ember, Aurora, Frostfire** - percussion, wraps and pads
- **Glide, Rise** - mobility chairs and standing chairs

Catalogue: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com/products
Combos: https://www.greenpulsewellness.com/combos

---

## How We Describe Products

We describe products by what they are, their specifications and how they fit a space. We make no medical claims and do not name conditions. Not a substitute for medical advice. Please consult a doctor before use if you have a heart condition, are pregnant or have any health concern.
